# PingOne DaVinci

> AI agents should consult [Docs for Agents](https://developer.pingidentity.com/build-with-ai/docs-for-agents.md)
> for guidance on navigating Ping Identity documentation.

## Davinci

- [Actions reference](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_actions.md): Reference for PingOne DaVinci actions, predefined node sets for registration, authentication, and account recovery available in the PingOne Marketplace.
- [Adding a connector](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/connectors/davinci_adding_a_connector.md): Add a connector in PingOne DaVinci to enable new capabilities for your flows, including core, Ping Identity, and service connectors.
- [Adding a variable](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/variables/davinci_adding_a_variable.md): Add a PingOne DaVinci variable, including its context, data type, initial value, and mutability.
- [Adding an item to the canvas](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_adding_an_item_to_the_canvas.md): Add connectors, user interface elements, or subflows to the PingOne DaVinci flow canvas using the plus icon.
- [Adding annotations](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_adding_annotations.md): Add annotations to a PingOne DaVinci flow canvas to make the flow easier to understand for yourself and other developers.
- [Adding DaVinci Admin Users in PingOne](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/davinci_adding_p1_admin_users.md): Add PingOne DaVinci admin users through PingOne by assigning the DaVinci Admin or DaVinci Admin Read Only role.
- [Adding SK-Components to a connector](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_adding_sk_components.md): Add SK-Components to the HTML Template of a PingOne DaVinci connector, such as the HTTP connector, to extend node functionality.
- [Adding social login with PingOne](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/use_cases/davinci_use_cases_adding_social_login.md): Add social login to PingOne DaVinci flows by configuring social login buttons on PingOne forms.
- [Applications](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/applications/davinci_applications.md): PingOne DaVinci applications control which flows external sites can run and how incoming requests are authenticated and managed.
- [Audit Trail](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/davinci_audit_trail.md): View PingOne DaVinci administrative audit events, now part of the PingOne centralized audit framework.
- [Best practices for creating subflows](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/davinci_best_practices/davinci_best_practices_subflows_creating.md): Follow PingOne DaVinci best practices for creating subflows, including naming conventions, CSS handling, and success and failure responses.
- [Best practices for data sharing](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/davinci_best_practices/davinci_best_practices_subflows_data_sharing.md): Follow PingOne DaVinci best practices for sharing data between a flow and a subflow using input and output schemas.
- [Best practices for using subflows](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/davinci_best_practices/davinci_best_practices_subflows_using.md): Follow PingOne DaVinci best practices for using subflows, including JSON response handling, styling, and avoiding excessive subflow nesting.
- [Branching](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/davinci_best_practices/davinci_best_practices_branching.md): Follow PingOne DaVinci best practices for branching flows, including logical operators, merging branches, and Teleport node placement.
- [Building flows](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/davinci_best_practices/davinci_best_practices_building_flows.md): Follow PingOne DaVinci best practices for building flows, including node titles, annotations, timeout values, and flow validation.
- [Change management](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/davinci_best_practices/davinci_best_practices_change_management.md): Follow PingOne DaVinci best practices for change management, including flow aliases, version control, and exporting flows for source control.
- [Changing a connector instance](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_changing_a_linked_connection.md): Change the linked connector instance for a PingOne DaVinci node while retaining its in-flow configuration.
- [Cloning a connector](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/connectors/davinci_cloning_a_connection.md): Clone a PingOne DaVinci connector to create a new connector with the same settings.
- [Cloning a flow](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_cloning_a_flow.md): Clone a PingOne DaVinci flow to create an identical new flow with the same steps and settings.
- [Cloning a node](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_cloning_a_node.md): Clone a node in a PingOne DaVinci flow to add an identical node to the canvas.
- [Collaborating](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/davinci_best_practices/davinci_best_practices_collaborating.md): Follow PingOne DaVinci best practices for collaborating with other flow builders, including using subflows and marking flows as in progress.
- [Common flow variables](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_common_flow_variables.md): Reference for common flow variables used in PingOne DaVinci flow templates, such as origin and originURL.
- [Company Settings](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/company_settings/davinci_company_settings.md): Configure PingOne DaVinci company settings, including environment name, custom domain, debug logging, and multiple flow execution behavior.
- [Configuring a flow policy](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/applications/davinci_configuring_a_flow_policy.md): Configure a PingOne DaVinci flow policy to control which flows and flow versions run, including weight distribution for A/B testing.
- [Configuring connection settings](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/applications/davinci_configuring_connections.md): Add connections to a PingOne DaVinci application to enable direct REST API interactions with a connector.
- [Configuring general application settings](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/applications/davinci_configuring_general_settings.md): Configure PingOne DaVinci application general settings, including API keys and FIDO2 connections for authentication.
- [Configuring OIDC settings](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/applications/davinci_configuring_openid.md): Configure OpenID Connect settings for a PingOne DaVinci application, including redirect URLs, scopes, grants, and JWKS.
- [Configuring SIEM Streaming](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/configuring_siem_streaming/davinci_configuring_siem_streaming.md): Configure PingOne DaVinci SIEM streaming to send DaVinci events to a PingOne webhook, using the event payload structure.
- [Connector types](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/connectors/davinci_connector_types.md): PingOne DaVinci offers core, Ping, service, and use case connector types to meet different flow orchestration needs.
- [Connectors](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/connectors/davinci_connections.md): PingOne DaVinci connectors provide the logic, user interfaces, and integrations with Ping Identity and third-party services that build flows.
- [Content Security Policies](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_content_security_policies.md): Configure Content Security Policy directives for PingOne DaVinci flows, including the baseline report-only and enforced policies.
- [Copying nodes](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_copying_nodes.md): Copy one or more nodes in a PingOne DaVinci flow to paste them into the same flow or a different flow.
- [Core connectors](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/connectors/davinci_core_connectors.md): PingOne DaVinci core connectors provide foundational flow functions, such as HTTP calls, JavaScript code, cookies, and branching logic.
- [Creating an application](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/applications/davinci_creating_an_application.md): Create a PingOne DaVinci application to enable flows to be launched through it.
- [Creating an authentication flow](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/use_cases/davinci_use_cases_creating_an_authentication_flow.md): Create a PingOne DaVinci authentication flow with password reset using the PingOne Sign On flow template.
- [Creating variables](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/davinci_best_practices/davinci_best_practices_variables.md): Follow PingOne DaVinci best practices for creating variables, including reusing variables, naming standards, and choosing variable context.
- [Dashboard](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/davinci_dashboard.md): View PingOne DaVinci dashboard analytics, including flow executions, connector executions, and custom outcome analytics.
- [DaVinci Best Practices](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/davinci_best_practices/davinci_best_practices.md): PingOne DaVinci best practices for building, maintaining, and securing flows, covering branching, variables, subflows, and debugging.
- [DaVinci browser support](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/usage_terms/davinci_browser_support.md): Reference for browser versions supported by PingOne DaVinci, including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and Internet Explorer.
- [Debugging and analytics](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/davinci_best_practices/davinci_best_practices_debugging_and_analytics.md): Follow PingOne DaVinci best practices for debugging flows and reviewing flow analytics, including debug mode, node IDs, and correlation IDs.
- [Deleting a connector](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/connectors/davinci_deleting_a_connection.md): Delete a PingOne DaVinci connector to permanently remove it.
- [Deleting a flow](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_deleting_a_flow.md): Delete an existing PingOne DaVinci flow.
- [Deleting a flow policy](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/applications/davinci_deleting_a_flow_policy.md): Delete a PingOne DaVinci flow policy to permanently remove it from use.
- [Deleting a node](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_deleting_a_node.md): Delete a node from a PingOne DaVinci flow to remove it and break any connections to it.
- [Deleting a user](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/users/davinci_deleting_a_user.md): Delete a user in PingOne DaVinci to remove all information about the user.
- [Deleting a variable](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/variables/davinci_deleting_a_variable.md): Delete an existing PingOne DaVinci variable to remove it from the UI and from all flows.
- [Deleting an application](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/applications/davinci_deleting_an_application.md): Delete a PingOne DaVinci application to permanently remove it from use.
- [Disabling or enabling a node](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_disablng_or_enabling_a_node.md): Disable or enable a node in a PingOne DaVinci flow to control whether it runs when the flow executes.
- [Editing a connector](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/connectors/davinci_editing_a_connection.md): Edit an existing PingOne DaVinci connector to update its properties.
- [Editing a flow policy](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/applications/davinci_editing_a_flow_policy.md): Edit a PingOne DaVinci flow policy to update which flows and flow versions are displayed to users.
- [Editing a variable](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/variables/davinci_editing_a_variable.md): Edit an existing PingOne DaVinci variable to change its description, data type, value, or mutability.
- [Editing flow settings](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_editing_flow_settings.md): Configure PingOne DaVinci flow settings, including general options, Content Security Policy, and other flow-wide configuration.
- [Editing the input schema](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_editing_the_input_schema.md): Configure the input schema of a PingOne DaVinci flow to map external parameters into the flow for dynamic content or logic.
- [Editing the output schema](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_editing_the_output_schema.md): Configure the output schema of a PingOne DaVinci flow using JSON schema to define the data returned when the flow completes.
- [Exporting a flow](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_exporting_a_flow.md): Export a PingOne DaVinci flow to create a backup file that you can analyze or import into another environment.
- [Flow editing options](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_flow_editing_options.md): Reference for PingOne DaVinci flow options in the More options menu, including enabling flows, showing node IDs, and analytics.
- [Flow limits](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_flow_limits.md): Reference for PingOne DaVinci flow limits, including maximum flows, connections, versions, and variables per environment.
- [Flow Policies](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/applications/davinci_flow_policies.md): PingOne DaVinci flow policies control which flows and flow versions launch through an application, including A/B testing options.
- [Flow policy metrics](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/applications/davinci_flow_policy_comparison_metrics.md): View PingOne DaVinci flow policy comparison metrics, including total visitors and success rate for each flow version.
- [Flow Validation Rules](https://docs.pingidentity.com/davinci/flows/davinci_flow_validation_rules.md): Reference for PingOne DaVinci flow validation errors and warnings, such as empty flows, floating nodes, and disabled nodes.
